metadata.title: Nga Thongba | Manipuri Style Fish Curry
metadata.description:
Tweet to share this recipe: https://ctt.ec/Bnsuq

Nga Thongba is delicious, spicy and tangy fish curry. It is a must item in a Manipuri feast, especially among the Meitei people of Manipur.  It is made by cooking fried fish pieces with tomatoes, onions and potatoes with aromatic spices and is served with steamed rice.
